name: Drive Downloads Lite
author: Drive Downloads Pro

sections.description:
Drive Downloads Lite adds a small, focused integration between WooCommerce and Google Drive:

  • Connect a Google account via OAuth (secure Google login).
  • Use a modern Google Drive picker inside the WooCommerce product editor.
  • Select folders or files and automatically fill the WooCommerce “File URL” field.
  • Use standard WooCommerce downloadable products to deliver files to customers.
  • Keep the admin UI consistent with the Pro version’s design.

The Lite version does not change Google Drive permissions or create private access per order. It only helps you generate and reuse public (or already shared) Google Drive links, so Google Drive access remains under your own configuration.
Even though the OAuth scope used is https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive, this Lite plugin only reads file, folder and user information (metadata and links) and never changes your Google Drive sharing settings or file contents.

A small banner on the settings page links to Drive Downloads Pro, which adds advanced features like per-order access, role control, and more:
https://drivedownloadspro.com/plugins/drive-downloads-pro/

What this plugin does

  • Adds a “Drive Lite” settings page in the WordPress admin.
  • Lets you configure:
    • Google OAuth Client ID
    • Google OAuth Client Secret
    • Google Picker API key
  • Provides a “Connect with Google” button (OAuth 2.0) to authorize access to Drive.
  • Adds a “Drive Lite” tab to the WooCommerce product data panels.
  • Adds a “Choose from Google Drive” button next to the WooCommerce download fields.
  • When you choose a folder or file from Google Drive, the plugin:
    • Builds the appropriate sharing URL
    • Inserts it into the WooCommerce download “File URL”
    • Optionally sets a default download name (for example: “Download”)

The actual access to the folder/file is controlled by your existing Google Drive sharing settings. Lite does not:

  • Grant or revoke permissions according to order status.
  • Change files or folders from private to public.
  • Add or remove users from Google Drive.

This keeps the Lite plugin small, predictable and easier to review from a security perspective.

Pro version

If you need more control over who can access your Drive content after purchase, you can upgrade to the Pro version:

  • Per-order Google Drive access (grant on completed order, revoke on refund/cancel).
  • Private customer-only access (by email).
  • Optional download/reshare restrictions where Google Drive supports them.
  • Additional security and permission options.

Learn more:
https://drivedownloadspro.com/plugins/drive-downloads-pro/

External services

This plugin connects to Google APIs in order to let you link Google Drive files or folders to WooCommerce products and use their URLs as downloads.

It uses the following Google services:

  • Google OAuth 2.0 endpoints (for example https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token and https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke)
    Used to connect your WordPress site with your Google account, exchange the OAuth authorization code for tokens, refresh the access token when it expires, and revoke access when you disconnect the account.
    The plugin requests the OAuth scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive. This scope technically allows full access to your Google Drive (including reading and managing files and permissions), but in the Lite version we only use it to read file, folder and user information needed to build download URLs and show connection details in the admin. The Lite plugin does not modify your Google Drive sharing settings or file contents.

  • Google Drive API (for example https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/... and https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/about?fields=user(displayName,emailAddress,photoLink))
    Used to validate the selected Google Drive file or folder and to obtain the necessary information (IDs, names, links, mime types, and basic user info) so that the correct URL can be inserted into the WooCommerce download field and the connection can be shown in the admin UI.

  • Google Picker JavaScript API (loaded from https://apis.google.com/js/api.js)
    Used in the WordPress admin to display the Google Drive picker window where you select the folder or file.

Data that is sent:

  • From your WordPress site to Google:

    • The OAuth authorization code when connecting your Google account.
    • The access token and refresh token exchanged with Google (they are stored only in your own WordPress database).
    • The selected Google Drive file and/or folder IDs when validating or retrieving metadata through the Drive API requests.

  • From Google to your WordPress site:

    • Basic information about your Google Drive user (for example display name, email address, and profile photo link).
    • Metadata about selected Google Drive items (IDs, names, URLs, mime types, etc.).

This plugin does not send any data to third-party services other than Google, and it does not send any tracking or analytics data to the plugin author.

Please review Google’s terms and policies for more details:

  • Google APIs Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from “Plugins → Add New”.
  2. Activate the plugin through “Plugins → Installed Plugins”.
  3. Go to the new Drive Lite settings page in the WordPress admin.
  4. In your Google Cloud Console:
    • Create an OAuth 2.0 Client (type “Web application”).
    • Add the plugin’s redirect URL shown on the settings page.
    • Create an API key for the Google Picker and restrict it by HTTP referrers.
  5. Copy and paste into the plugin settings and save:
    • Client ID
    • Client Secret
    • Picker API key
  6. Click Connect with Google and complete the OAuth flow.
  7. Edit a WooCommerce product and enable “Downloadable”.
  8. Go to the Drive Lite tab and use the Choose from Google Drive button to select a folder or file.
  9. Publish or update the product. WooCommerce now uses that Google Drive URL as the download.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin make my Google Drive content private per customer?

No. The Lite version only helps you select Google Drive folders/files and insert their URLs into WooCommerce downloads. It does not manage individual user permissions or per-order access.

If you need automatic grant/revoke of access per order, private links or more advanced control, you will need the Pro version:
https://drivedownloadspro.com/plugins/drive-downloads-pro/

Are the links public or private?

The plugin does not force any sharing mode by itself. It uses the share URL returned by Google Drive and you remain in control of how each folder or file is shared.

For a simple “Lite” setup, you typically configure your Drive items as “Anyone with the link can view” and then use those URLs as WooCommerce downloads.

Does the plugin upload or host my files?

No. Files stay in your Google Drive account. The plugin only works with URLs and the Google Drive API.

What data does the plugin store?

The plugin stores in your WordPress database:

  • Google OAuth tokens (access / refresh tokens).
  • Your Google Client ID / Client Secret / API key.
  • The selected Google Drive URLs linked to each product.

Access tokens and secrets are stored as WordPress options and may be additionally encrypted using PHP’s encryption functions when available (libsodium or OpenSSL). No file contents are copied into your WordPress site.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

The plugin itself does not create new customer fields. It uses the existing WooCommerce order and customer data and works with Google Drive through their API.

As with any site that processes personal data, you should:

  • Review Google’s privacy terms.
  • Document the use of Google Drive in your privacy policy.
  • Ensure you have an appropriate legal basis for processing data.

Can I use it without WooCommerce?

No. This plugin is built specifically for WooCommerce downloadable products and requires WooCommerce to be active.

Does it work on multisite?

The plugin is designed to work on standard single-site and basic multisite setups. Each site manages its own Google connection and settings.

2.0.0

  • First public release of Drive Downloads Lite.
  • Google OAuth connection and token storage.
  • Google Drive picker integration in the WooCommerce product editor.
  • Automatic insertion of Drive folder/file URLs into WooCommerce downloads.
  • Pro upgrade banner on the settings page.
